fix_instructions: Tighten check C3 by requiring the model to explicitly state the exact number of documented interruption incidents (which must be 3 per PF1) in addition to selecting the facilitator type. This prevents the model from passing based solely on the qualitative presence of interruption-related text in the shared facts.
